newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Montreal Q1 loan losses flat.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal Q1 loan losses flat.

text.p: Bank of Montreal said on Tuesday that its first-quarter provision for loan losses was unchanged at C$69 million from the year ago period.
The bank said impaired loans of C$145 million at January 31 fell by C$219 million from October 31, 1996 and by C$395 million from January 31, 1996.

The bank said it would finalize provisions in the third quarter. The current C$275 million annual provision was unchanged from the level forecast this time last year, but up by C$50 million from the full-year 1996 level of C$225 million.
